description: November 20 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 3, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 20 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the third decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a November 20 birthday
paragraphs: Twenty-seven degrees of Scorpio, late in the Moon decan, gives the 20th of November a tender, intuitive cast. Twenty reduces to 2, numerology's number of partnership and attunement. Together, they suggest someone who forms intense one-to-one bonds and reads emotional undercurrents with ease. The traditional growth point is trusting that closeness can survive a little more openness.

By noon UTC on November 20, the Sun has normally reached roughly 27° of Scorpio. That places the date in the Scorpio decan that astrologers give to Moon, the third of three. The final decan of Scorpio takes the Moon as sub-ruler, the luminary that governs Cancer. Mid-to-late November birthdays therefore blend Scorpio's depth with a strong protective and domestic instinct. Those born here are commonly described as fiercely loyal to family and close friends, sensitive to atmosphere and slow to forget either kindness or betrayal. The lunar influence can make moods shift quickly beneath a composed surface. When they feel safe, these natives tend to offer remarkably steady emotional support, the kind that stays through the difficult chapter and not just the easy one.

sections.heading: Numerology of the November 20 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same November 20 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: November 20 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 20 is the 324th day of the year (325th in a leap year). In most years Sagittarius season is under way by November 23, 3 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. November 20 is also the birthday of Joe Biden (1942), Selma Lagerlöf (1858) and Nadine Gordimer (1923).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 20?
faq.answer: November 20 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 20 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 20?
faq.answer: By November 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 20?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a November 20 birthday are Joe Biden (1942), Selma Lagerlöf (1858) and Nadine Gordimer (1923). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
